items.title: The LDS Church Tried to Take the Word “Mormon” Away From Me | Full History of Its Trademark Battles
items.summary: A Mormon News Roundup YouTube video says the LDS Church's lawyers sent a cease-and-desist letter in May 2025 demanding it stop using the name Mormon News Roundup, and traces the church's history of trademark disputes over the word "Mormon."

items.title: 3 Arizona children ask US Supreme Court to look at church's protections under religious confession
items.summary: 12 News reports that three children who were sexually abused by their father are asking the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that shields church leaders from reporting abuse.

items.title: "Dear Bishop": The Mormon Ponzi Scheme Behind VesCor and Val Southwick
items.summary: A Postmormon Postmortem video recounts the VesCor investment scheme, describing a Mormon bishop and businessman, Val Southwick, and a Ponzi scheme of about $180 million that it says drew in members.

items.title: Ground broken for La Paz Bolivia Temple, a place to find ‘peace’
items.summary: Church News reports that ground was broken Nov. 21 for the La Paz Bolivia Temple, with Elder Juan Pablo Villar presiding, on a site where the church says construction is expected to take about three years.

items.title: LDS leaders have warned against treating A.I. like God. Are members listening?
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that a survey of nearly 1,800 U.S. Latter-day Saints by researchers at BYU-Idaho and the University of Southern California suggests many members see no problem using A.I. in their spiritual lives, despite warnings from apostles including Gerrit W. Gong and David A. Bednar. The study identifies a group it calls "Silicon Saints" that it says is growing.
